name: Stop on your verse
title: 45 verses
note: Reel published; Pillow reinstalled with --ignore-installed because the system copy was broken
caption:
Hold the screen and stop on a verse. Which one did you land on?

Forty five verses about mercy, peace for tomorrow, and a God who hears you in the morning. Every one of these is true, so whichever verse you stop on, you can lean your whole weight on it.

45 verses from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB)
